mapper.insert: insert into todo_items (title, time_limit, priority, category_id, done_flg, done_flg2, parent_id, parent_title) values (#{title}, to_date(#{time_limit}, 'yy-mm-dd'), #{priority}, #{category_id}, #{done_flg}, #{done_flg2}, #{parent_id},#{parent_title})
mapper.update: update todo_items set title = #{title}, time_limit = to_date(#{time_limit}, 'yy-mm-dd'), done_flg = #{done_flg}, priority = #{priority}, category_id = #{category_id}, done_flg2 = #{done_flg2}, parent_id = #{parent_id}, parent_title = #{parent_title} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo_items WHERE done_flg = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_id, id), CASE WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id
